ApplicationConfig.description:
The application entity and the two fields the gateway, never the chat
host, writes.

ownerField.description:
The field identifier of the field that records the citizen's
principal. It names a different field than `targetField`.

targetField.description:
The field identifier of the field that references the citizen's own
record.

AuditConfig.description:
The audit block every Registry Stack product shares: the hash key, then a
`file` (the default) or `stdout` destination, with rotation and retention
for a file.

hashKeyRef.description: Secret reference to the audit hash key.

path.description:
The absolute path of the active audit file. Required for a `file`
destination, and refused with `stdout`.

retentionDays.description: Days a rotated file is kept, for a `file` destination. Default: 90.

rotateBytes.description:
Size at which the active file rotates, in bytes, for a `file`
destination. Default: 100 MiB.

AuditDestinationKind.description: The configured audit destination kind, as written in product configuration.

oneOf.description: One JSON line per entry on standard output, flushed per entry.

DetailsConfig.description:
The entity holding the citizen's own record, found through the agent
profile's linked lookup.

EnvironmentSecretProviderConfig.description: The environment secret provider. It takes no settings.

ExchangeConfig.description:
The gateway's own client identity, used only to exchange a verified
inbound token for a delegated registry token.

assertionAudience.description:
The client-assertion audience, when the authorization server expects
one other than its token endpoint. Omitted, the assertion names the
token endpoint.

clientId.description:
The gateway's client identifier at the authorization server. It may
not also be one of `resourceServer.allowedClients`.

privateKeyRef.description:
Secret reference to the private JWK the gateway signs its client
assertions with, under a declared provider.

tokenEndpoint.description:
The authorization server's token endpoint. An https URL with no query
or fragment; plain http is accepted only on a loopback host under
`development-loopback`.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

root.description:
Absolute directory holding one file per secret. Each file must be a
regular file owned by the runtime user, mode 0400 or 0600, with exactly
one hard link.

JwksSource.description: Where a runtime obtains the OIDC issuer's signing keys.

oneOf.description: Read `jwks_uri` from the issuer's OpenID Connect discovery document.
Fetch the key set from this absolute `https` URI, skipping discovery.

Read the key set from a secret, for deployments without network access
to the issuer.

maximumRequestBytes.description: Largest request body the MCP endpoint reads, in bytes.

ListenerBind.description: Socket address the runtime listens on, written host:port with an IP address host ([addr]:port for IPv6).

ListenerNetworkExposure.description: The operator-declared private network placement of an HTTP listener.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

PrivateListenerConfig.description:
The listener of a runtime that declares its TLS termination and network
exposure.

burst.description: Requests admitted at once before the average applies.

requestsPerMinute.description: Requests admitted per minute, on average.

perCitizen.description: The limit each citizen's requests share.

perClient.description: The limit each chat-host client's requests share.

RegistryConfig.description: The outbound half: the registry the gateway acts on.

accessProfile.description: The standing agent access profile every call names.

attemptTimeoutMilliseconds.description:
How long one registry call may take before it is abandoned, in
milliseconds.

audience.description: The registry's token audience, requested as the exchange resource.

baseUrl.description:
The registry deployment's base URL. An https URL with no query or
fragment; plain http is accepted only on a loopback host under
`development-loopback`.

scopes.description: The scopes requested for the delegated registry token.

ResourceServerConfig.description: The inbound half: how a chat host's access token is verified.

algorithms.description: The asymmetric signature algorithms an accepted token may use.

allowedClients.description: The chat-host clients whose tokens the gateway accepts.

issuer.description:
The exact issuer accepted in access-token `iss` claims. An https URL
with no query or fragment; plain http is accepted only on a loopback
host under `development-loopback`.

jwksSource.description:
Where the issuer's signing keys come from. Omitted, they are read
through the issuer's OpenID Connect discovery document.

maximumTokenLifetimeSeconds.description:
The longest lifetime an accepted access token may declare, from its
`iat` to its `exp`, in seconds.

requiredScopes.description:
Scopes every accepted token must carry. There is no sentinel for
"any scope": a gateway that acts for a citizen always names the
scope that consent was given for.

resource.description:
This gateway's resource identifier: the exact URL of its MCP endpoint,
which every accepted token must name as its audience. An https URL
whose path is `/mcp`, with no query or fragment; plain http is
accepted only on a loopback host under `development-loopback`.

scopeClaim.description: The access-token claim that carries the granted scopes.

ResourceUri.description: An RFC 8707 resource indicator: an absolute URI without a fragment. The reader also refuses user information and a URI it cannot parse.

ScopeToken.description: An RFC 6749 scope token: printable ASCII other than space, `"`, and `\`.

SecretProvidersConfig.description:
The secret providers a runtime enables. A reference is resolved only by a
provider declared here: `secret:file/name` under `file.root`, and
`secret:env/NAME` only when `environment: {}` is present.

environment.description:
Enables `secret:env/NAME` references, read from the process
environment. Declared as an empty mapping: `environment: {}`.

file.description: Enables `secret:file/name` references, read from files under `root`.

SecretReference.description: An exact secret reference: secret:file/name, resolved under secretProviders.file.root, or secret:env/NAME, resolved only when secretProviders.environment is declared.

ServiceConfig.description:
The authored service a citizen is told about, and the registry entities
its tools work over.

disclosure.description: What the citizen is told about the data the chat host will see.

reviewBaseUrl.description:
The citizen-facing review page; an application is reviewed and
submitted there, never through the chat host. The review page's
`publicOrigin`, with no path, query, or fragment.

ServiceText.description: Text a citizen reads: not blank, at most 4096 characters.

TlsTermination.description:
Declares the trusted transport boundary for a runtime's plaintext HTTP
listener. Production listeners require operator-controlled upstream TLS
termination; direct plaintext is limited to the explicit loopback-only
development mode.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host, no user information, and no whitespace or control character.

exchange.description: The gateway's own client identity at the authorization server.

registry.description: The one registry deployment and access profile the gateway acts on.

resourceServer.description: Who may call the gateway: the chat hosts' authorization server.

title: Base Registry Engine MCP gateway runtime configuration
